question: Who among the following was awarded with the MS Swaminathan Environment Protection Award 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anant Darshan Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The** MS Swaminathan Environment Protection Award** is instituted to recognize individuals or organizations for their contributions towards **environmental protection and sustainable development.**
 
• In 2024, **Anant Darshan Shankar**, a pioneer in the field of integrative health sciences and traditional knowledge systems, was honored with this award.
 
• Anant Darshan Shankar is the **Founder of the Foundation for Revitalisation of Local Health Traditions (FRLHT)**, which focuses on conservation and sustainable use of medicinal plants and local health traditions.
 
• The award highlights his significant efforts in **promoting biodiversity conservation and sustainable practices** for the protection of the environment.
 
• The recognition also underscores the role of traditional knowledge in addressing contemporary environmental challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MS Swaminathan:**

 
 
• Known as the **"Father of the Green Revolution in India,"** MS Swaminathan played a crucial role in introducing high-yielding crop varieties to Indian agriculture.
 
• He emphasized the importance of sustainable and environment-friendly agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Integrative Health Sciences:**
 
 
• It is an approach that combines modern medical practices with traditional knowledge systems to promote holistic well-being.
 
• Anant Darshan Shankar has been a strong advocate for this approach, particularly in the context of biodiversity conservation.
 
 
 
• **Foundation for Revitalisation of Local Health Traditions (FRLHT):**
 
 
• A Bengaluru-based organization founded by Anant Darshan Shankar in 1993.
 
• It works to preserve traditional health practices and medicinal plant species through research and community engagement.
 
 
 
• **Medicinal Plant Conservation:**
 
 
• Medicinal plants are critical for both traditional medicine systems and modern pharmaceuticals.
 
• Conservation efforts focus on sustainable harvesting, cultivation, and protection of biodiversity.
